body.heading: Paint your flags
paragraphs: Cut or fold paper into triangles or rectangles. Paint each one brightly so it can be seen from far away.
Try stripes, spots, or a big smiling sun. Wet paint needs a few minutes to dry.

body.heading: Hang and watch
paragraphs: Your adult tapes the flags along a string and hangs it somewhere safe outside.
Watch them flutter. On a still day they hang quietly; on a windy day they dance.

takeaway: A flag shows you the wind you cannot see.
safetyNotes: An adult hangs the flags and checks they are secure and away from any road.
screenFreeExtension: Make a new flag for each season and watch how the garden changes around them.
